name: PostHog MCP
description: Gives coding agents hosted MCP access to PostHog analytics queries, SQL, feature flags, experiments, and error tracking, with OAuth or a personal API key.

skills.name: Feature Flag Management
skills.description: Creates, updates, and rolls out PostHog feature flags from a prompt using the 29 tools in the MCP server's feature flags category.

skills.name: Experiment Management
skills.description: Sets up, inspects, and analyzes A/B tests and their results through the experiments category of PostHog MCP tools.

skills.name: Error Tracking Triage
skills.description: Ranks top error groups, pulls full stack traces for crashes, resolves issues, and creates assignment rules for future errors.

skills.name: SQL And Insights
skills.description: Runs HogQL queries with execute-sql and creates, reads, or deletes product analytics insights and dashboards in a PostHog project.
